data.name: Drops of Renewal
data.description: Summons celestial dew to heal yourself
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands, invoking a soft, luminous chant. From above, ethereal droplets of dew descend, shimmering with celestial light. The dew gathers upon %user and their allies, mending wounds and revitalizing spirits. As the healing touch takes effect, a sense of tranquility washes over the battlefield, bolstering resilience against further harm.

data.name: Water's Domain
data.description: Encase your foe under a torrent of water.
data.battleDescription: %user engulfs %target in a powerful surge of water, dealing damage while sapping their strength.

data.name: summontester
data.description: Fireball like jutsu
data.battleDescription: %user activates sage mode and now has access to all Senjutsu

data.name: Blazing Flash
data.description: Envelops the user in flames to move with explosive speed.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra, igniting flames that swirl around their body. With a sudden burst of energy, they propel themselves forward at blinding speed, leaving a trail of fire in their wake. The intense heat generated by their movement scorches the ground and air, making it difficult for the opponent to follow their path. As %user moves, the flames around them roar and grow, turning their rapid dashes into fiery streaks that sear anything they touch. The final strike comes when %user reappears behind the opponent, the flames concentrating into a devastating kick or punch, sending a wave of fire through the opponent's body, engulfing them in a burst of flames. The battlefield is left smoldering, with %user standing amidst the remnants of their fiery dash.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Black Sun Funeral
data.description: A banned solar incineration art that folds scorch and explosion chakra into a false sun. The blast is overwhelming, but the user's own life force burns with it.

effects.description: A collapsing black sun tears through the target.
The target is left exposed by solar burns.
The user's forbidden heat sharpens their next attacks.
The black sun consumes the user's body and chakra.

data.battleDescription: %user clasps both hands and crushes the light above the battlefield into a black sun. The sphere drops behind %target without sound, then blooms into a white-hot funeral pyre that strips shadows from the ground. As %target reels, %user's veins glow like cracked embers, their own chakra reservoirs collapsing under the forbidden heat.

data.name: Amaterasu's Renewal
data.description: Raid wide cleanse. Used on allies only.
data.battleDescription: "%Amaterasu's Renewal" is used her light washes away all evil.

data.name: Quicksand Nightmare
data.description: This Genjutsu traps the target in an illusion where they are slowly sinking into a pit of quicksand.
data.battleDescription: %user's eyes flash with a subtle glow, and suddenly %target feels the ground beneath them give way. In the illusion, %target begins to sink into a pit of quicksand, the earth swallowing them inch by inch.

data.name: Earthshaker Blade
data.description: Infuses a weapon with earth chakra to create seismic shockwaves.
data.battleDescription: %user channels earth chakra into their weapon, causing it to emit a powerful aura. With a mighty swing, they strike the ground, releasing a seismic shockwave that travels towards %target. The shockwave splits the earth, creating fissures and throwing %target off balance while dealing substantial damage.

data.name: Mask of the Hollow Mountain
data.description: The boss dons a mask of stone and shadow, shrugging off harm.

effects.description: Absorb damage taken & convert to health, chakra or stamina

data.battleDescription: %user dons the hollow mask, and blades slide away from the stone.

data.name: Tempest's Whispers
data.description: Sends haunting whispers carried by the wind to unsettle the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user whispers into the wind, their voice carried on the breeze to %target's ears. The eerie, disembodied voices echo around %target, filling their mind with doubt and fear. As the whispers grow louder and more insistent, %target becomes increasingly paranoid and distracted, unable to focus on the battle at hand.

data.name: Demolishing Vortex
data.description: This technique involves imbuing weapons with a unique chakra that upon contact or close proximity, can disrupt and weaken opponent's weapons.
data.battleDescription: With unmatched speed and precision, %user begins to spin, their weapon trailing a visible vortex of chakra-infused air. As %user approaches %target, the swirling chakra vortex becomes a weapon-withering force.

data.name: Electric Surge
data.description: The user creates an illusion of a sudden surge of electricity coursing through the target's body, causing them to feel a brief, intense shock.
data.battleDescription: As %user invokes the Electric Surge genjutsu, %target is enveloped in an illusionary surge of electricity. %target reacts instinctively, jerking as if shocked. The sensation is vivid, causing %target to momentarily lose focus, creating an opening for %user's next move.

data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm to the ground, releasing a bloom of glowing lotus-shaped seals that spread outward in a perfect circle. The lotus petals rise upward, forming a radiant, semi-transparent barrier of light around %target

data.name: KGK: Veilguard Pulse
data.description: Kuroganekai operatives utilize this defensive technique to endure prolonged engagements and maintain battlefield pressure. Veilguard Pulse surrounds the user in a concentrated blacksteel barrier that absorbs incoming attacks while reinforcing their defenses.
data.battleDescription: Dark violet energy erupts around %user as Veilguard Pulse forms a reinforced barrier, absorbing incoming attacks while shielding %user from harm.

data.name: Summon: Totem of Watatsumi

data.battleDescription: %user channels Earth Release chakra into their fists, delivering a barrage of strikes that causes the ground to erupt. Earthen hands emerge, immobilizing %target's legs. %user finishes with a crushing kick, sending %target to the ground, leaving them unable to move.

data.battleDescription: %user dashes in with a swift slash imbued with high-pressure water, striking %target with explosive force. The slicing current crashes through defenses, leaving the enemy off balance and more susceptible to follow-up Bukijutsu attacks.

data.name: Quicksand Illusion
data.description: Conjures an illusion of sinking into quicksand.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the earth, creating an illusion that the ground beneath %target has turned into quicksand. %target feels their feet sinking and their movements becoming increasingly sluggish. Panic sets in as they struggle to free themselves from the illusory quicksand, leaving them vulnerable to %user's next attack.

data.name: Earth Release: Seven Heavenly Pillars

data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands into the earth, summoning seven towering stone pillars that burst upward beneath %target. The crushing force damages them on impact and leaves them staggered, reducing their ability to strike effectively.

data.name: Inferno Leech
data.description: A cursed flame technique that burns the enemy and forms a barrier that absorbs incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user casts a writhing blaze of cursed fire that latches onto %target. As the flames ignite, a portion of the energy feeds back into the user’s chakra system, forming a reactive shield that absorbs damage taken while the effect lingers.

data.battleDescription: With a quick motion, %user launches a small, blade-shaped burst of wind chakra at %target. The wind dart flies through the air with impressive speed, aiming to pierce %target's defenses and deliver a precise and piercing strike.

data.name: Infernal Ascension
data.description: The user calls upon sacred flames, their aura igniting with unholy fire - elevating the power of their every blaze to new, merciless heights.
data.battleDescription: %user ignites their chakra into roaring flame, every motion blazing with destructive intensity. Their body radiates searing heat as they ascend into a state of relentless aggression, striking with explosive bursts of fire chakra. With each move, the user channels infernal energy that fuels their flame-based attacks, overwhelming the battlefield in blazing dominance.

data.name: Pyretic Ignition
data.description: Engulfs the target in an overwhelming illusion of being consumed by flames.

No matter how %target struggles, the flames continue to consume them, spreading across their body in a relentless, agonizing inferno.

data.name: Earth Release: Earthquake
data.description: The user slams their foot into the ground, sending shockwaves of earth towards the target, disrupting their balance and causing tremors to radiate outward.
data.battleDescription: With a powerful stomp, %user channels chakra into the earth, creating fissures that race toward %target. The trembling ground and flying debris overwhelm %target, leaving them off balance and vulnerable.

data.name: KGK: Flash Step
data.description: A high-speed movement technique utilized by Kuroganekai operatives to overwhelm targets before they can properly react. Flash Step propels the user through the battlefield in a burst of dark violet energy, striking nearby enemies and disrupting their combat rhythm.
data.battleDescription: %user bursts across the battlefield in a streak of violet energy, Flash Step tearing through %target disrupting their ability to retaliate effectively.

data.name: Planetary Ruin

data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand together, using %target as the focal point, the earth around them begins to break apart and flying towards %target crushing them under the immense earthen pressure

data.name: Descending Annihilation
data.description: An incredible genjutsu that creates the illusion of a cataclysmic tornado engulfing the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra with precision, conjuring a terrifying illusion of a colossal tornado descending upon %target. The roaring winds and deafening roar of the tornado overwhelm %target's senses, as they feel themselves being swept up into the vortex of destruction.  Panic descends, leaving %target unable to distinguish between reality and the fabricated, devastating storm.

data.name: Gale Dance
data.description: Mixing graceful movement with the embrace of the wind element, this technique draws in opponents before leaving them reeling.
data.battleDescription: %user moves gracefully, creating wind currents that pull %target closer. With swift strikes, the rending winds tear through %target, dealing damage amidst a serene yet deadly dance of the storm.

data.name: Solar Flare Kick
data.description: Harnesses fire chakra to execute a dazzling kick that emits blinding light upon impact.
data.battleDescription: %user delivering a burning hot kick that emits a burst of blinding light.

data.battleDescription: %user manipulates the dust particles in the area infusing them with their chakra, as %target breaths in the dust particles they begin to attach to his organs destroying them

data.name: Binding Ribbon Barrage

data.battleDescription: With a quick flick of %user wrists, red ribbons shoot from her back, flying towards %target at breakneck speed. Before they can react the ribbons wrap around %target binding them in place.

data.name: Crimson Surge
data.description: A punishing chakra strike that damages the enemy and makes their jutsu cost more chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user launches a surge of volatile chakra that tears into %target’s system. The strike damages them directly and scrambles their inner flow, forcing them to burn more energy when casting jutsu.

data.name: Blazing Slash
data.description: This jutsu coats the holder’s weapon in intense flames, enhancing it’s damaging attributes.
data.battleDescription: With a quick touch, %user ignites his weapon in a flash. %user quickly descends on %target with immense speed and with a single swing releases a fiery arc, scorching %target on contact.

data.name: Gale Palm Strike
data.description: A swift wind-enhanced strike that boosts the user’s Taijutsu power and closes distance with precision.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward, carried by slicing currents of wind chakra. Their body glides low across the battlefield like a stormfront breaking through resistance. With a flash-step and a palm strike infused with sharp, compressed air, they slam into %target with explosive force. As the wind detonates from their strike zone, %user’s chakra flares—amplifying their Taijutsu output in the aftermath.

data.name: Gaia's Wrath
data.description: This jutsu enables the user to create a massive hammer made of the elements and smash their opponents with incredible might.
data.battleDescription: %user jumps high into the air and draws a long pole. As %user reaches the peak of their jump they start to channel incredible amounts of earthen chakra into the end of the pole to form a huge hammer of natural elements. Mere moments later, %user comes down with the weight of the earth and devastates %target with massive force.

The dew gathers upon %user and their allies, mending wounds and revitalizing spirits. As the healing touch takes effect, a sense of tranquility washes over the battlefield, bolstering resilience against further harm.

The gust slashes towards %target, aiming to slice through their defenses and inflict damage with the cutting force of the wind.

The electrified aura causes %target to feel a numbing sensation, slowing their movements as if wading through molasses. The sensation hampers %target's agility, making it challenging to evade attacks.

data.battleDescription: %user lashes out with a swift, bladed whip of condensed water chakra that carves into %target with razor precision. As the whip extends and recoils, it channels violent chakra flow through %user’s system, boosting their ninjutsu potency for subsequent strikes.

data.name: Earth Release: Consuming Earth

data.battleDescription: %user summons a dense wave of shifting earth chakra that strikes %target with forceful precision. The impact not only harms the body but disrupts their internal chakra discipline, dulling the potency of their ninjutsu and genjutsu while sapping the sharpness of their intelligence and willpower-based attacks.

data.name: Marshmallow Inferno
data.description: Delusions immerse the target in a sweet yet nightmarish illusion. The target perceives themselves as a marshmallow aflame, melting into gooey oblivion. They feel the heat, the gradual melting, and the sensation of being sandwiched between chocolate and graham crackers.
data.battleDescription: %user casts Marshmallow Inferno Delusion upon %target. The illusion takes hold, enveloping %target in a fiery, gooey nightmare. %target feels the heat, senses their melting form, and experiences the bizarre sensation of being pressed between chocolate and graham crackers, trapped in a surreal, sugary oblivion.

data.name: Abyssal Wraith
data.description: Conjure illusions of malevolent wraiths that haunt the target's perception, inducing mental strain and escalating torment.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures the Abyssal Wraith, infusing %target's perception with illusions of malevolent wraiths. The haunting figures induce mental strain, escalating the torment experienced by %target. %user exploits the target's compromised mental state, launching calculated strikes that take advantage of their distracted defenses.

data.name: Lightning Drift
data.description: Drift like lightning through the battlefield.
data.battleDescription: In the midst of combat, %user channels their chakra into the air, infusing it with the raw energy of lightning. With a sudden surge, they vanish in a streak of light, their body becoming as fluid and unpredictable as a lightning bolt. Weaving through obstacles and enemies alike, %user appears and disappears in rapid succession, their movements too fast to be tracked by the naked eye. As they drift through the battlefield, crackling electricity trails behind them, leaving the opponent disoriented and vulnerable. The air around %user hums with static, making it clear that the storm is far from over.

data.name: Chakra Palm
data.description: A palm strike that channels raw chakra into %target and forms a protective shield around the user.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses raw chakra into the center of their palm, the energy pulsing with refined control. They strike %target in a focused burst—disrupting the target’s stability with a precise, chakra-packed hit. Upon impact, the released energy recoils around %user, forming a semi-transparent barrier of rotating chakra.

data.name: Cyclone Slash
data.description: The user executes a spinning slash, creating a small cyclone around their weapon that increases its range and damage.
data.battleDescription: As %user spins with incredible speed, a cyclone forms around their weapon, extending its reach and power. The cyclone engulfs %target, slashing at them from all sides with cutting winds. The force of the cyclone creates a whirlwind effect, lifting %target off the ground and leaving them vulnerable to further attacks from %user's Bukijutsu or Wind techniques.

data.name: Hydro Pressure
data.description: Compresses water to strike with extreme force.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses water chakra into a dense, pulsating orb and slams it into %target, unleashing a high-pressure blast that pierces defenses and delivers crushing internal damage.

data.name: Water Release: Hiding Water Technique

data.battleDescription: %user melds into surrounding water, vanishing from sight while preparing for a precise counterattack.

data.name: Aqua Dragon Barrage
data.description: A relentless barrage of water dragons that crash into the target with crushing force.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a series of water dragons that surge forward in rapid succession, each one slamming into %target with overwhelming pressure. The combined force of the barrage floods their defenses and strikes from multiple angles, delivering devastating aquatic impact.

data.name: Rotting Bite
data.description: A genjutsu that inflicts the target with a rotting disease. Targeting the body with disgusting images and weakening their mind.
data.battleDescription: %target feels a sharp sting as the illusion of rotting flesh spreads across their body. The horrific vision saps their will, activating lifesteal for %user as their strength feeds into the caster.

data.name: Ember Nightmare
data.description: Conjures an illusion of burning embers, causing severe psychological torment.
data.battleDescription: With a sinister smile, %user begins to chant, their voice low and menacing. They form a sequence of hand seals with practiced precision, and a wave of intense heat radiates from their body. %target suddenly finds themselves surrounded by a swirling vortex of glowing embers, each spark igniting a new wave of fear and pain. The embers cling to their skin, causing excruciating burns that feel all too real. The acrid scent of burning flesh fills the air, and %target's screams are drowned out by the crackling roar of the illusory flames. Each ember burrows deeper into their psyche, causing them to relive their worst fears and pains. The relentless onslaught leaves %target mentally scarred and physically debilitated, their will to fight reduced to ashes by %user's ruthless genjutsu.

data.name: Fire Release: Inferno
data.description: A raging sea of flames that overwhelms the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a torrent of fire that engulfs %target, consuming them in relentless, burning fury

data.name: Torrential Fist
data.description: A brutal, storm-fueled punch that crushes foes and awakens the beast within.
data.battleDescription: % A low hum fills the air as %user’s fist clenches, veins glowing faintly with surging water chakra. The liquid spirals violently around their arm, no longer gentle like a stream but raging like a storm barely contained. With eyes locked on %target, %user surges forward—each step leaving splashes in their wake. The punch lands with a brutal crash, detonating in a geyser of pressure that feels more like a tidal eruption than a strike. Steam rises from soaked ground as %user pulls back, aura pulsing, their strength now amplified by the very force that sought to drown their enemy.

data.name: Weary Fists
data.description: A heavy taijutsu strike that absorbs part of the damage the user receives
data.battleDescription: %user approaches with grounded steps, chakra coiling around their arm like lead. They drive a deliberate, crushing punch into %target, the force transferring with bone-deep weight. On impact, residual chakra lingers around %user, hardening into a dense field that absorbs a portion of incoming damage.

data.name: Anchor the Storm
data.description: Channel the Stormanchor's grounding current into the earth, sheltering the bearer and all allies beside them from a killing blow.

effects.description: Anchored ground shelters all within from the storm's killing blow
A dome of grounded pale light

data.battleDescription: %user drives the Stormanchor's current into the ground. For one breath, nothing in the sky can kill those anchored beside them.

data.name: Earth Release: Dragon's Tomb
data.description: A powerful Earth Release Ninjutsu that summons a massive dragon-like creature made of earth and stone. The dragon emerges from the ground and can deal substantial damage to the opponent while also decreasing their stats and increasing yours.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a colossal dragon-shaped mound of earth that entraps %target, draining their power while fortifying their own.

data.name: Phoenix Heart
data.description: A fierce illusion ignites the battlefield, weakening the enemy’s mind while amplifying the caster’s genjutsu power.
data.battleDescription: The user’s chakra flares with ethereal fire as they weave hand signs that blur the line between reality and illusion. %target finds themselves engulfed in a rising inferno of rebirth, their thoughts seared by the haunting cries of a celestial phoenix. As their mental defenses crumble, the user’s own genjutsu prowess surges, emboldened by the ashes of the enemy’s weakening will.

data.name: Rooting Punishment
data.description: Kinmokuzai Punish
data.battleDescription: %user sprouts gigantic vines that slam all across the battlefield in a rage at nothing being in range to infest

data.name: Chakra Barrier
data.description: Hardens the body with chakra to reduce damage taken.
data.battleDescription: The user channels their chakra outward in a controlled burst, forming a faint, shimmering barrier across their body. Though not visible to the untrained eye, this layer of energy dampens the force of incoming attacks, absorbing impact and minimizing harm. Genin learn this technique as a fundamental method of defense when faced with overwhelming power.

data.name: Tidal Surge
data.description: A ruthless water attack that damages the enemy and hardens the users defense
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a crushing tide with Title Search, slamming %target with relentless force as the waters shield their caster in a fortress of flowing defiance.

data.name: Savage Blade Cyclone
data.description: Empowers the user's sword with a fierce wind chakra, initiating the Savage Blade Cyclone. The blade not only damages the opponent but also allows the user to swiftly move across the battlefield with the force of the wind.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their sword, unleashing the Savage Blade Cyclone. With each strike, the blade not only damages the opponent but propels %user across the battlefield, repelling any attacks that come towards them

data.name: Field Test
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Venomous Phobia.
data.description: A fear-inducing poison technique that increases how much damage the target takes.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a silent, airborne toxin that bypasses the skin and seeps into the mind. As %target inhales the faint mist, illusions twist into phobias—hallucinations of venomous creatures crawling beneath the surface. The fear tightens their body and frays their nerves, making them far more vulnerable to incoming attacks as their composure breaks.

data.name: Thorn Grasp
data.description: This jutsu creates a long thorny vine that is utilized to control opponents while lightly damaging them with puncturing wounds.
data.battleDescription: %user summons spiked vines that wrap around %target, stunning them with their piercing grip

data.name: Primate Assimilate
data.description: Gain the ability to briefly absorb damage.

effects.description: Absorb damage taken & convert to health, chakra or stamina

data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, performing the Primate Assimilate jutsu. Through this technique, their simian ally gains the power to absorb the abilities or attacks of their opponents, enhancing their combat prowess. The bond between %user and their monkey comrade grows stronger as they share this unique ability.

data.name: Chakra Invigoration
data.description: A quick movement technique that energizes the user and boosts their stats.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a burst of chakra-enhanced motion, leaving afterimages as they reposition across the battlefield. As their body moves, internal chakra flow heightens—enhancing physical and mental performance all at once.

data.name: Scorching Illusion
data.description: Induces the sensation of burning alive.
data.battleDescription: %user completes a series of swift hand seals, their chakra flaring with intense heat. Suddenly, %target feels an unbearable burning sensation across their body. The illusion is so vivid that %target's mind is convinced their skin is blistering and charring. This excruciating pain overwhelms %target, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable to %user's next move.

data.name: Pill Pack: Stamina Pill III
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user bites into a green pill which immediately seems to increase their muscle mass.

data.name: Storm's Lullaby
data.description: This jutsu cloaks the battlefield in an ominous sound of crackling thunder, the sound disorients those who hear it and seems to deflect attacks.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels their chakra, a low rumble of distant thunder echoes across the battlefield, disorienting the opponent. The air around the opponent thickens, making every movement feel like a struggle through water. Their senses dull, and the world slows to a crawl, while %user appears to blur with lightning speed.

data.name: Graveyard of Stone
data.description: An earth-based genjutsu that hits hard, overwhelming the target with visions of their body being buried and crushed alive by jagged stone.
data.battleDescription: The user performs a silent sequence of hand seals before slamming a palm to the ground. In an instant, the terrain warps in the target’s vision as they are plunged into a nightmarish realm of collapsing cliffs and shifting tombs. The enemy sees themselves standing in a vast graveyard where every headstone bears their name. Stone hands erupt from the earth, grabbing at their limbs and dragging them downward as the sky rains jagged obsidian boulders. With each phantom impact, real pain blossoms—blurring the line between illusion and reality. The oppressive weight of stone breaks their focus and crushes their will, delivering devastating damage through sheer psychological terror.

data.name: Cursed Enchantment
data.description: A cursed barrier that reduces damage taken and drains the enemy stats
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds themselves in cursed embers, dulling incoming strikes as the flames crawl over %target, sapping their strength with every flicker.

data.name: Phantom Breeze
data.description: Creates an illusion of chilling winds to lower the enemy’s morale.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a spectral breeze that chills %target to the bone. The cold, biting winds sap %target’s strength and resolve, creating an illusion of frost forming on their skin and equipment. As the phantom chill seeps into their bones
